visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing a light beige button-down shirt, sits in the driver's seat of a white Tesla Model S interior. He holds a red-cased iPhone, gesturing toward the camera. The background is a dimly lit underground parking garage with concrete pillars and overhead fluorescent lights visible through the car windows. (2) The scene transitions to a vertical screen recording of the iOS 'Shortcuts' application. The interface displays 'Automation' settings with various personal tasks. A red digital arrow highlights the plus sign at the top right. The UI flows through menus for 'Bluetooth' selection and choosing 'Tesla Model S' as a trigger device. (3) The man returns to the frame inside the car, speaking directly into the lens while subtly moving his phone to emphasize points. His facial expressions are animated, showing an informative and helpful demeanor. (4) A secondary screen recording displays the top portion of an iPhone's status bar. A green chain-link icon appears in the upper left corner, indicating the successful activation of the personal hotspot. (5) The video concludes with the man back in the car seat, finishing his explanation. He smiles and gestures with his hands before the video loops or ends.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 不用花199 也能讓特斯拉有網路. [Slogan]: 大家知道特斯拉的免費網路. (2) [Subtitle]: 即將開始收費了 接下來每個月費用是199. (3) [Subtitle]: 那教大家一個簡單的方法 就可以省下199. (4) [Subtitle]: 只要你一上車 手機就會自動打開熱點 然後讓你的特斯拉連結到網路. (5) [Subtitle]: 大家可以看到在捷徑的APP裡面 我們打開自動化 在自動化這一欄按加. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後按加的時候呢你可以選擇 當你的藍牙連接到什麼. (7) [Subtitle]: 當我的藍牙 然後已連接 然後裝置就會選擇 當我的藍牙連接到我的特斯拉Model S的時候呢. (8) [Subtitle]: 下一步立刻執行打開熱點 設定個人熱點 然後把熱點開啟. (9) [Subtitle]: 然後再按打勾它就開始了. (10) [Subtitle]: 那因為熱點一直開著會很耗電 所以你下車之後呢 我還設定了另外一個 剛剛的步驟再一次. (11) [Subtitle]: 只是變成 你的藍牙只要一斷開特斯拉 就自動把熱點關閉. (12) [Subtitle]: 所以現在我只要一上車 你可以看到它自動 就有熱點跑出來 然後一下車 熱點自動就關閉相對的省電. [Variety]: 熱點打開了. (13) [Subtitle]: 這樣一來一回 只要你的是4G或5G的吃到飽 你就不用花199 買特斯拉網路了.
